statement: The explicit rank-two involution alpha(a)=b^-1 a^epsilon b, alpha(b)=b^-1 a^kappa has split extension exactly N amalg C2, with the prescribed torsion-free virtually procyclic N. Every involution in this extension has trivial centralizer in its rank-two free kernel. Trace excludes every three-cusp marking. Every once-punctured-torus marking is excluded because its multiplier is det A=-epsilon and a norm-adjusted cusp-normalizing involution would centralize the nonzero Z3 cusp subgroup. The natural cusp has additional explicit order21 and PSL2(F7) finite quotient certificates.
depends_on: A-HerfortZalesskii2008, Theorem 5 of inspected author version
manuscript_passages: Part D: full rank-two loop actions and precise peripheral conditions
notes: Mutually inverse generator substitutions prove the free-product comparison and the exact rank-two kernel. The regular mod2 module calculation and Brown restriction prove unique kernel-conjugacy of involutions; full free-factor malnormality then makes every kernel-centralizer trivial. For an arbitrary torus marking, exact determinant and norm comparisons contradict that fact. The separate finite quotient test is stated only for the natural cusp.
